messages:
Yuki Tanaka: Hi @Maria — I'm back from my 6mo in Barcelona as of 2026-03-01. How do we wind down the WFH stipend and local benefits? Need to update homebase to US. Also worried about lingering tax nexus. Thx.

Maria (People Ops): Welcome back! Congrats. We'll need a homebase change via the 'Declare Homebase' form. Stipend will be pro-rated through your last day abroad. Can you confirm your last working day in BCN? CC'ing payroll.

Yuki Tanaka: Last day was 2026-03-01 (first day back 2026-03-02). Also: do I need to return the monitor and router we shipped out?

Remy (Payroll): Hi Yuki — we'll calculate the pro-rata stipend through 2026-03-01. Please fill the 'Stipend Close / Return' form: https://go.redwood/forms/stipend-close. We'll need the BCN shipping address for tax paperwork and the exact stipend payment dates. CC @Maria.

Maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up: if any relocation reimbursements were taxable, payroll will flag them. Benefits: once your legal residence/homebase is set to US in the system, your US benefits and commuter options will resume. If you exceeded 183 days there may be tax nexus implications — we have to open a tax review. Do you want us to open that ticket?

Yuki Tanaka: I was there 184 days exactly. Please open the tax review. Also, can I keep the router? It was cheaper to ship than to replace. @Remy

Remy (Payroll): Policy is to return durable assets unless manager signs off on retention. Please ask Jamal for approval; once approved, send a short email to ops@redwood.com with subject 'Asset retain request — Yuki' so we can update inventory and avoid a charge.

Jamal (Manager): Approved — Yuki can keep the router. No sensitive hardware on it.

Maria (People Ops): Thanks Jamal. Yuki — I'll trigger the homebase change and flag payroll for a one-off stipend proration adjustment. Expect a confirmation email and a paystub note once processed. I'll also open the tax review ticket (TAX-2026-042) and loop you in.

Onboarding Bot: Form submitted: Declare Homebase — received. Ticket HR-78912 created for homebase change. You should get next steps in 3-5 business days.

Yuki Tanaka: Thanks all. One last Q: do I need to re-enroll in commuter benefits? I was on Barcelona transit alternatives while abroad.

Maria (People Ops): For US commuter benefits you'll need to opt back in via the benefits portal after your homebase change is complete. We'll email step-by-step re-enrollment instructions. @Remy — payroll will need to re-enable pre-tax deductions post-change.

Remy (Payroll): Confirmed. Once homebase is updated we'll reinstate pre-tax commuter deductions effective the next payroll cycle. If you want it sooner, submit the benefits change form and we'll try to expedite.

Yuki Tanaka: :thumbsup: appreciate it, will fill the forms today.
